title: Zaffer Does ORS a Favour

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: If it isn't my pal. You looking for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it isn't my pal. You looking for me?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: I’m just messing. You are kinda Corpy though. No offense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m just messing. You are kinda Corpy though. No offense.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Woah careful there. Sounds like you're about to indulge in an act of kindness. Those are outlawed you know. Strictly profitable services only.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah careful there. Sounds like you're about to indulge in an act of kindness. Those are outlawed you know. Strictly profitable services only.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Don’t zaff for Lims. You know that. Say what you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don’t zaff for Lims. You know that. Say what you want.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: A statement? Now I’m interested. Who’s it for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A statement? Now I’m interested. Who’s it for?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Could say that. We used to be... familiar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could say that. We used to be... familiar.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: For you? Always. And for Delbert. He’s as punk as mustard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For you? Always. And for Delbert. He’s as punk as mustard.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Told you, I don't work for Corpsters. See you around, mate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Told you, I don't work for Corpsters. See you around, mate.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Have I told you lately that neon suits you? In fact, I know some that’d look good in your apartment. How about I bring it round some time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have I told you lately that neon suits you? In fact, I know some that’d look good in your apartment. How about I bring it round some time?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: I can? I mean, I can. Later, then. Keep the lights on for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can? I mean, I can. Later, then. Keep the lights on for me.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Delbert has good energy. Zaffy, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Delbert has good energy. Zaffy, you know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need someone to make a statement on the Oil Rig. Something eye-catching.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need someone to make a statement on the Oil Rig. Something eye-catching.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need someone to make a statement on the Oil Rig. Something eye-catching.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need someone to make a statement on the Oil Rig. Something eye-catching.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why wait? You can bring it around tonight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why wait? You can bring it around tonight.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why wait? You can bring it around tonight.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why wait? You can bring it around tonight.

/// spawn article about hacked neon
Zaffer.HacksRig = true
